---
title: "Test"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
set.seed(42)
library(multidesign)
library(tibble)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r test}
n_trials <- 40
n_regions <- 50
X <- matrix(rnorm(n_trials * n_regions), n_trials, n_regions)

design_df <- tibble(
  condition = rep(c("face", "house"), each = 20),
  trial = 1:40,
  run = rep(1:4, each = 10)
)

column_info <- tibble(
  region = paste0("ROI_", 1:n_regions),
  hemisphere = rep(c("left", "right"), 25),
  network = rep(c("visual", "frontal", "parietal", "temporal", "default"), 10)
)

mds <- multidesign(X, design_df, column_info)
folds <- fold_over(mds, run)
folds

# Debug output
cat("folds class:", class(folds), "\n")

fold1 <- folds[[1]]
cat("fold1 class:", class(fold1), "\n")
cat("fold1 type:", typeof(fold1), "\n")

nrow(xdata(fold1$analysis))
nrow(xdata(fold1$assessment))
```
